environment: Offline mobile Chromium; actual PDF.js saved bytes, mocked narrow native export transport, independent PyMuPDF export/render inspection; physical Android not tested

results.name: Original PDF and source-linked note are retained before editing
Icon editing controls expose current tool and pen colour through language changes and text cancellation
Finger-drawn signature belongs to page 2; undo and redo restore the edit
Save copy produces a new PDF identity, real exported ink and unchanged original bytes
Saved annotation survives reload and original note reopens original PDF/page
Closing editing tools restores ordinary one-finger PDF scrolling
Edits on separate pages survive zoom and viewport rotation; delete removes only selected edit
Intrinsic page rotation maps exported ink onto the correct visible region
English and Arabic added text retain visible appearances in the actual saved PDF
Long English and Arabic tokens wrap without clipping their added-text annotations
Pointer-selected text highlighting is retained in the exported PDF
Form fields export filled values and checkbox state
Cancelled and failed native exports never claim a successful file save
Pending native export prevents PDF interaction and retains edits on cancellation
Unavailable Android export channel refuses saving without discarding or importing edits
Cancelling an import while edits are unsaved preserves the active PDF and its identity
An unfinished ink stroke triggers the document-switch guard
Editor works without Ollama, server or external network requests
